name: Oxford Brookes University

sources.title: UKVI Credibility interviews - Oxford Brookes University
quotes: Why do you want to study in the UK?
What have you learned about the UK education system?
What are the benefits of studying in the UK compared to your home country?
Which other countries did you consider (e.g. USA, Canada, Australia), and what were your academic reasons for choosing the UK rather than other countries?
What do you know about Oxford Brookes University and why is it the best University for you to study academically?
What do you know about the campus where you will be studying?
What facilities and support services does the university offer?
Where is Oxford located? How close is the campus to the city centre?
How is the course related to your previous studies or work experience?
Which modules are you most interested in, and why?
How will the course be assessed (e.g. exams, coursework, projects)?
How will the course help you with your future career goals?
How will you pay your tuition fees?
How will you pay for your living expenses and accommodation?
If your parents or a sponsor are funding you, how can they afford it?
What is your estimated monthly living cost in Oxford?
Do you plan to work part-time during your studies?
Are you aware of UK student visa work restrictions?
How much will your accommodation cost?
What are your career plans after completing your course?
Do you plan to return to your home country? Why?
How will this qualification support your long-term goals?
sources.notes: Page is Brookes' guidance on the UKVI credibility interview: 'They will test this by inviting you to a credibility interview via Microsoft Teams following an email invite from them'; 'You MUST ensure that you attend the interview and you must not ask someone else to attend the interview on your behalf'; decision-maker is 'the UKVI caseworker'. Search snippet from the same page: 'if you do not pass this stage then your visa will be refused. It is very difficult to overturn a credibility refusal, and normally Oxford Brookes University will not issue you with another CAS if you receive a refusal for credibility'; 'The interviewer will not know anything about your visa application or your course, so you need to give full and detailed answers'; 'The questions listed may not be the exact ones you are asked, but if you have an answer for all of them, you should be well-prepared.' Three main topic areas per snippet: why UK/Brookes, study and post-study plans, paying for course and living costs.

sources.title: Next steps - Oxford Brookes University
sources.notes: No question list. Page mentions a 'Higher pre-CAS interview threshold' for applicants from India Punjab state, Pakistan and Bangladesh: '7.0 overall required with 7.0 in the four core questions' - confirms Brookes runs a scored pre-CAS interview with four core questions, but the questions are not listed.

sources.title: CAS Shield
sources.notes: brookes.cas-shield.com resolves (HTTP 200) and serves Enroly's CAS Shield login page (page text contains 'Enroly' and 'CAS Shield'), so Oxford Brookes University uses Enroly CAS Shield for its CAS process. Enroly pre-CAS interviews draw randomised questions from themed banks; no question list is published on the site.

Questions sit under a heading 'Real Oxford Brookes questions students are asked' but the page itself says the themes are common credibility-interview patterns drawn from UKCISA guidance, so treat as low-weight, not university-specific evidence.
